html:
SMTO-EXE-0160 — SMTO got a reply from the Gateway it couldn't understand

GUID: 887998ff-e91f-5988-aeef-2653a8c28e46
Slug: ui-invalid-response
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • The Gateway's computer answered SMTO's desktop step, but the answer was incomplete or not what SMTO expected. If the step was a click or typing, it may have happened anyway.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the step was meant to change something, look at the app on the Gateway's computer to see whether the change is already there. SMTO couldn't read the confirmation, so it doesn't know whether the change happened.
  2. Tell SMTO in the conversation what you see, and ask it to repeat the change only if it clearly didn't happen. Repeating a change that already happened could do it twice.
  3. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways, select Check for updates, and install a Gateway update if one is offered. A Gateway that is older or newer than SMTO's server can send replies the server doesn't understand.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's next desktop step returns a normal result, and the app shows any change only once.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO and the Gateway; this usually needs a software fix. Don't repeat a click or typing step until you've checked the app.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Server or Gateway rejected a Desktop UI response that failed contract validation (wrong typed fields, inconsistent element data, or an oversized or malformed body); for write operations the effect is unknown.

What this means

  • UI result validation rejected incompatible typed fields, unsafe/inconsistent element data or malformed transport response. The invalid receipt alone cannot establish mutation outcome. Only the existing explicit UI request may observe or mutate the selected desktop. Secure values stay redacted, stale references are not retargeted, and uncertain native input is not automatically repeated.

Why this can happen

  • UI result validation rejected incompatible typed fields, unsafe/inconsistent element data or malformed transport response. The invalid receipt alone cannot establish mutation outcome.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect structural response diagnostics and original effect certainty; do not expose protected values while reporting the defect.

How to fix it

  • Compare the Server and Gateway versions and update the Gateway if they differ, and check the Gateway log for this operation. For write operations treat the receipt as effect_unknown and reconcile with ui.snapshot or ui.element before repeating; report a persistent malformed response as a defect.
  • Inspect the original receipt and current target state; report the structural contract defect. Reconcile possible effects before repeating input.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect ui.status and a fresh scoped ui.snapshot on the selected Gateway. Correct the target or prerequisites before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The original action is reconciled and the adapter supplies a valid bounded response for future work.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, read secure fields, record input or bypass OS permissions.

Technical notes

  • Only the existing explicit UI request may observe or mutate the selected desktop. Secure values stay redacted, stale references are not retargeted, and uncertain native input is not automatically repeated.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
